869: A pond and watermill build themselves under the picture, water runs down the flume, the keeper frees the gate rope and the wheel starts turning while ducks ride the wash.
4081: The sitter's tiled pavement comes out across the floor and his dog walks to the last tile, lifts a paw, then trots back under the pointing hand, sits and stays.
4428: The wall and floor go dark, a counter corner slides out with a carafe, and flowers come down stem by stem to build the bouquet, each ringing the glass.
4758: A lane with a tree, cart and horse forms from white flecks; dew weighs a bough down until it sheds a shower into the puddle and the horse shakes itself.
4773: A table and chair come out, then Isabella Wolff walks in toy-sized, her satin gown catching light at each step, sits and bends over her book of prints.
4788: Smoke curls from under the frame and a garland of flowers comes down it and sweeps into a ring; a fallen rose rises to close it into a hanging wreath.
4796: A sea wells over the floor, a fishing boat and a boat of buyers call notes until they match, the sun breaks through and a basket is swapped for coins.
8991: Two cannons fire coloured shapes that sound the notes of Musorgsky's Promenade and hang like a score; driving into a shape plays its note and bumping a cannon fires it.
11723: A powder puff falls from under the frame, the picture paints itself in the hanging powder and falls as dust; the toy leaves tracks and can nudge the puff.
14572: The shop bell rings, hat stands grow from the floor and the hats flutter out like birds, fly round the floor to a music box and land on the stands.
14574: A glazed door's light falls on the floor with a table of papers, the door comes ajar and a draught slides the newspaper off; driving past stirs the papers.
14591: A café table with a glass slides out, a journal lands on it and turns its pages, a breeze blows one leaf loose and the glass pins it down.
14598: A calm sea wells over the floor floating two boats, then ebbs to leave them aground on a shingle beach; stones crunch and a boat rocks as the toy passes.
14620: A grassy cliff top grows on the floor, two women walk out, a gust snatches the parasol and it is chased and caught; the grass parts round the toy.
14655: Balls of wool tumble out and roll away unwinding, the green strand climbs the wall as a flowering creeper with a singing bird; push the balls and they unwind further.
15401: A table and panelled wall are laid in, two doors open as a looking-glass holding a crowded restaurant, and the toy appears in the mirror among the diners.
16146: A circus ring spreads on the floor, a clown hidden behind a paper hoop climbs a stool, and a riderless grey horse canters round and leaps through the paper.
16151: A small window opens low in the gallery wall onto the painting's distant country, where cattle graze and two white birds take wing and fly off over the hills.
16298: The wall darkens and a tasselled cord draws the hidden back of the panel in the air: initials, shield and a scroll that unrolls reading GRACES A DIEV.
16487: The picture is dealt onto the floor as playing cards, forming mountains, a bay and a village of card houses with red roofs, then a chimney puffs white smoke.
16488: Dark water runs over the floor, a shield rolls out and leans on a rock, a cloud blows in and catches the toppling shield before it can clang.
16495: An old magician is brushed in under the picture, touches his wand to a shield that fills with a far shore's light, then turns to the empty place beside him.
16551: Dusk gathers in the corner and a gold sundial opens on the floor; its shadow comes round to nine and stops, far bells sound and gold motes rise.
16568: A pond spreads over the floor with lily pads, opening flowers and a frog that leaps and sings; the toy can drive on it, rippling water and nudging pads.
16584: Fog rolls over the floor, a river and Parliament's skyline are brushed in to clock chimes, and each bell stroke sends a swell across it; fog parts round the toy.
18951: Footlights and scenery flats rise from the floor, the orchestra tunes and three dancers in yellow come out, pirouette to Swan Lake and curtsey.
19339: A toy-sized garden corner comes out with a bush, red fence and two bare trees, which are wrapped in straw cones that hold when the mistral blows through.
20579: Rocks rise beside the frame and the seven-headed Hydra comes up hissing a chord while Hercules's club, bow and lion skin lay themselves ready; afterwards the heads watch the toy.
20684: Rain falls in the gallery, the floor becomes wet paving with puddles and Parisians under umbrellas walk out; the toy can splash through, and it awards the secret Rain indoors.
23333: Dark water runs over the floor with reeds, a white dog's head paddles across and a duck bathes, stands up and beats its wings, soaking the dog.
24684: A table corner comes out with a green book and a gold cameo that lifts and turns upright to show a woman's profile; the toy's position lights the carving.
25865: Fog and a heavy swell come out across the floor, a red keg float rides out, herring glint under the surface and the line is hauled in from the fog.
27307: A strip of white muslin slides out under the picture, a needle on a thread sews five stitches into it and gathers it into a frill, to a hummed lullaby.
27943: The painted pool comes out as a slow tide of flat colour shapes across the floor; drive into it and the shapes swirl round the toy and rings spread.
27987: The couple walk out, she sits on a stool, he rests a hand on her shoulder, and they hold the pose while their name is lettered on the wall.
28560: His bedroom builds itself toy-sized on the floor like a pop-up book, then gets ready for sleep: chairs waddle, shutters close and the coverlet tucks itself in to Brahms's lullaby.
28849: A sandy path runs out over the floor and a tiny woman walks its length, growing as she comes, and sits on the bench; the toy leaves wheel prints.
43145: The view is brushed in under the picture in cool shade, then sunlight finds the temple dome and runs down to the meadow while a pipe plays a Delphic hymn.
44018: A lawn unrolls with hoops, balls and four croquet players who play a shot; afterwards the toy can knock the balls, and putting one through a hoop awards a secret.
44892: A cloth and copper pot are brushed onto the floor, a lemon rolls round the pot and a gleam follows it across the copper; the toy can push the lemon.
57051: Stone stairs, two statue bases and their basins slide out of the wall; sunlight comes down the treads, the bronze masks start pouring water and the basins fill.
59891: A quill falls out, a knife cuts its tip, paper unrolls down the wall, and the pen dips in the ink box and draws the view from the picture's window.
60755: Water spreads on the floor and the ruin rises from it; two birds circle, a storm gust catches them, they shelter inside the tower through the rain, then sun returns.
61128: Gas globes light, a silhouette crowd rises and four poster dancers run out and dance a quadrille to Offenbach's galop, ending in the splits, while a top-hatted gentleman joins in.
62371: A yellow chair is drawn in blue outline and filled with colour, then a tracing of its outline is carried across, set down, leans over and is coloured too.
64729: Tall pines grow up the wall either side of the picture, a bird wheels overhead and turns gold in the first sun, then daylight comes down the trunks.
64818: Wheat grows up through the floor, ripens, is cut by an unseen scythe and pitched into the picture, leaving stubble with long blue shadows; the toy casts one too.
65916: A red disc drops out and an orange one orbits it trailing an ochre band of white arrowheads; afterwards the arrows trail the toy, which can nudge the red disc.
69780: Brushstrokes pour out and stand up as a fountain, an easel and two painters; as the woman paints the jet on her canvas, the fountain's jet goes up.
76571: A waterfall spills from under the frame into a gold lake on the floor, palms grow, a canoe paddles round, and volcano smoke rises and trails along the wall.
80607: His brushstrokes spill onto the wall round the frame, beating like a heart, then pour down into a whirlpool on the floor that circles the toy wherever it drives.
81507: A field and low house appear at dusk; hens walk home under the thatch, a window lights, and the cock left alone in the field runs in last.
81512: A woman built of brushstrokes reads at a table to a Chopin prelude, which stops when she looks up at you; afterwards she looks up whenever the toy drives close.
81533: A turf course and crowd come out, horses burst from the wall and race round it; the toy can race them and the crowd cheers it past the post.
81539: A river covers the floor with an upside-down village in it and a woman on the bank; the village stands up from its reflection, which breaks round the toy.
81545: The floor becomes a snowy sunset field and five wheat stacks hop out, each hiccuping, to a music box tune, then grow snow caps as snow falls.
81558: A sawdust circus ring comes out and brushstrokes form two small acrobats who juggle and pass five oranges to Offenbach's galop, then one cartwheels and more oranges fly in.
84709: A stone window slides out with a quince and cabbage swinging on strings and fruit rolling on the sill until all is still; driving past sets the hanging two swinging.
87045: Red fruit roll out painting the table top in ribbons, a jug pours blue strokes into a pot, and a geranium grows leaf by leaf and flowers to Debussy's Arabesque.
87479: A cold silver light climbs the wall behind the frame and veils of blue, rose, yellow and green rise from behind its top toward the ceiling, to a Victoria motet.
90048: Rock and autumn woods rise from the floor, a river slides out and falls over the brink, spray climbs the wall, then sunlight crosses and a rainbow appears.
93900: Brushstrokes pour out, whirl on the floor and draw the empty costume in the air; it bows, strokes streaming like ribbons, and takes the picture's pose to a Mouret fanfare.
94841: The painted lark climbs out onto the top of the frame, sings, and flies a loop round the gallery trailing warm motes, while dawn light and wheat come up below.
95998: The floor darkens and a shaft of light opens; a gold chain runs down the wall, its medal rolls out and spins flat, and a black plume floats down.
109780: Ice spreads over the floor, skaters glide out and circle to the Skaters' Waltz while a child and a woman spin; the toy can skate among them, carving the ice.
109819: A blank square canvas comes down the wall, is heaved onto its point and fills with Mondrian's lines and colours, leaning until balanced; push it and it rocks upright again.
109926: A long roll of cloth patterned with the picture's painted border of leaves is hauled up the wall behind the frame on two cords and hangs there like a tapestry.
109938: Brushstrokes wheel round the frame, an avalanche of snow bursts onto the floor and becomes a roaring whirlwind, thunder flashes twice, then the snow settles in a gold-lit drift.
110507: A sea runs out over the floor, a harp rises from it and plays Schubert while its reflection echoes the notes; the toy leaves rings and brushes the strings.
110760: A pale green sea is laid along the floor with rocks, sheep, an island and Penelope's house, and a dark ship sails its length to touch shore by her loom.
111317: A swag of green silk drops beside the frame and the Comte steps out, turns to look up at his own portrait, then glances back at you and nods.
111436: A white tablecloth falls to the floor, apples bounce and roll out across it and two biscuits land flat; the toy can drive into the apples and send them rolling.
111442: A rug rolls out, a basin and jug slide onto it, the jug pours water and soap bubbles float up through the gallery and pop, on the toy too.
111559: A sandy path comes out and the ram trots out with the boy on its back and bleats, three lambs answer, then it leads them round to a minuet.
111610: A formal garden is laid out on the floor and eight potted trees walk out of the casino door in pairs to a minuet, take their places and bow.
120154: The shelf of dessert slides out of a dark, the urn's glass lid lifts and comes down and everything rings; driving past or against the shelf rings it again.
144969: Sunlight runs over the floor and a toy-sized palm house grows, its fans opening and dappling the floor; the toy can drive under the palms and the leaves lean aside.
146953: Dry earth spreads on the floor and three cattle walk out of the wall; one cow lies down and chews the cud while the young bull looks at you.
150054: A strawberry drops from under the frame, takes root and sends out runners until a bed of plants stands under the picture and its berries ripen red.
153798: A trellis opens along the wall like a fan with a hedge on it, then a blue fan beats in a bush and the leaves turn into the seated woman.
154235: Night runs over the floor and moonlight falls on it as four window panes with a curtain's shadow, dimming when a cloud passes; the toy throws a shadow in it.
218072: A stem of pinks grows from the floor under the painted hand, its two flowers open, then turn and close face to face like the panels of a diptych.
